title: Ibn Al-Haytham Hospital — Our Doctors, Anesthesia Doctors and hospital details
notes: Official site is ihh.com.jo (ibnalhaytham.com does not answer). /Doctors/Index lists 39 doctors on one page (name, headline, phone extension) + 39 detail pages (only repeat the headline); /AnesthesiaDoctor/Index lists 6 more. English only: the Arabic switch (/Language/Arabic) returns 403 to scripted clients, so no name_ar. specialty = published headline verbatim; grade only where headline says Consultant/Specialist. clinic_phones = switchboard +962 6 520 5555 with the published extension (one card shows a full number in the extension field - kept in extra only). Per-doctor WhatsApp mobile links on the site were deliberately NOT collected (possible personal mobiles). No fees/schedules published. robots.txt allows all but /admin/ and /temp/.
